issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for singFarmSongVerse(Animal): The problem statement's textual instructions state that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be public for testing, but the UML in the problem statement marks singFarmSongVerse as private (a minus sign). Both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) declare singFarmSongVerse as private. This inconsistency (text vs UML vs code) confuses students about the intended visibility and can cause tests that expect a public helper method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of singFarmSongVerse consistent across all artifacts. Two acceptable resolutions: (A) If tests require access to the helper, change the method signature in both the template and the solution to public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and update the UML (problem_statement.md) to show the method as public; or (B) if the helper should be private, update the textual instruction in the problem statement to remove the requirement that singFarmSongVerse be public and clarify it is a private helper. Recommended: prefer (A) so tests can access the helper—update template and solution Farm.java to declare the method public and update the UML snippet in problem_statement.md to mark the method as public.
